name: StickyStackCards
description: Cards pin one after another inside a smooth-scroll viewport, each settling a few pixels below the last, while the cards underneath scale down and dim in proportion to how many cards cover them.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" with an aria-label, so keyboard users can Tab to it and scroll with arrows/Page keys/Space (native, unsmoothed) and see a 2px :focus-visible outline. Wheel input is smoothed only while the viewport can still move; at the top/bottom edge wheel events are released so the page keeps scrolling. Touch and scrollbar dragging stay native. Under prefers-reduced-motion (or smooth=false) the wheel is not intercepted at all. Cards are an ordered list with real text titles; glow and chart decorations are aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the stack still pins but covered cards are not scaled.

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.description: Card titles, one stacked card per item.

propsApi.name: offset
propsApi.description: Vertical step in px between stacked cards.

propsApi.name: scaleStep
propsApi.description: Scale reduction applied per card covering an earlier card.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Accent color for card glow, chip and chart bars.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the component's own scroll viewport in px (width is always 100%).

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: lerp
propsApi.description: Interpolation factor per 60fps frame for wheel smoothing (0.05 floaty, 0.3 snappy).

propsApi.name: wheelMultiplier
propsApi.description: Multiplier applied to wheel and trackpad deltas.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Enable smooth wheel scrolling; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native scrolling.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
